- **Watch the transmission channel, not the headline:** the market that cared about oil on Friday cared about *yields*.
- With 10Y back above 5.13% and BofA's survey showing managers need 5.9% to rotate out of equities, every oil-driven inflation print widens the AI trade's discount-rate headwind.
